name: Brightspot
description_en:
Brightspot is an enterprise content platform combining structured authoring, editorial workflows and content delivery. Its current commercial offer distinguishes Hybrid, with a design system and editorial tools, from Headless, an API-first foundation with GraphQL and content types. Managed operations and optional services form part of the buying decision.

It is most useful to evaluate a concrete editorial process and delivery architecture together. Workflow status, saved work, publication and future revisions have distinct meanings; access rules can allow an authorized publisher to override intermediate steps. Public pricing describes a tailored scope without a numeric starting rate.
description_zh:
Brightspot 是企业内容平台，将结构化创作、编辑工作流和内容交付结合。当前商业方案区分 Hybrid（设计系统及编辑工具）与 Headless（含 GraphQL 及内容类型的 API优先基础）；托管运营及可选服务也是采购范围。

应将具体编辑流程与交付架构一起评估。工作流状态、保存中的内容、公开发布和未来修订含义不同，权限规则可能允许有权发布者跳过中间步骤。公开定价描述定制范围，未给数字起价。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose integrated design/editorial tooling or a headless foundation; frontend and integration work depend on the architecture.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选集成设计/编辑工具或无头基础，前端及集成工作取决于架构。

core_features.explanation_en: Define statuses, transitions, site scope and required comments, then restrict transitions through roles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可定义阶段、转换、站点范围和必填评论，再以角色限制转换。

core_features.explanation_en: Background WIP saves, named versions and scheduled revisions support editorial work without making every saved edit public.
core_features.explanation_zh: 后台 WIP 保存、命名版本和定时修订支持编辑，并非所有保存都会公开。

pricing.summary_en: Tailored Hybrid or Headless foundation with managed operations and optional capacity/security/developer/service scope. No numeric public rate established; allowances, renewal, SLA and implementation require a proposal.
pricing.summary_zh: Hybrid 或 Headless 定制报价，含托管运营，可选容量/安全/开发/服务范围；未建立公开数字价，额度、续费、SLA及实施需提案。

sections.title_en: Decide how content reaches the audience
sections.title_zh: 决定内容如何到达受众
sections.en:
The current pricing page offers Hybrid for teams wanting a design system, prebuilt content types and editorial tooling, and Headless for teams controlling delivery through GraphQL and their own endpoints. That is an architecture decision, not simply a cheaper-versus-more-expensive tier comparison: no numeric rates are shown. A headless team still has to build or operate its presentation layer and verify previews, routes, cache refresh and media handling.

For a publisher with a public site and an application, choose a representative article containing reusable media and metadata, then ask which fields, templates and endpoints are included in the proposal. The user guide distinguishes editorial content types, site settings and platform extensions. This is a proposed evaluation, not a tested multi-channel deployment.
sections.zh:
当前定价页为需要设计系统、预建内容类型及编辑工具的团队提供 Hybrid，为通过 GraphQL 和自有终端控制交付的团队提供 Headless。这是架构选择，不能仅视作高低价档位比较，因为页面未显示数字价格。无头团队仍需开发或运营展示层，并验证预览、路由、缓存更新及媒体处理。

例如同时有公共站和应用的出版团队，可选一篇包含复用媒体及元数据的代表文章，确认报价包含哪些字段、模板和终端。用户指南区分编辑内容类型、站点设置及平台扩展。上述为建议评估，未经多渠道部署测试。

sections.title_en: Check override rights as well as transition rules
sections.title_zh: 同时检查跳转规则与发布覆盖权限
sections.en:
Administrators can create workflows for particular sites and content types, add statuses and transitions, require comments and restrict transitions by role. Unpublished existing assets enter a newly created workflow, whereas already-published items are exempt until a revision or republishing puts them into it. A team changing its review policy should therefore inspect the existing content population as well as new drafts.

The workflow guide explicitly documents Publish Override for a role with Publish permission when the next workflow status is inaccessible. This is an intentional authorized bypass, so a diagram alone does not establish mandatory approval separation. Test an author, reviewer and publisher with realistic permissions, including rejection and override. Bulk workflow movement is also not the same as bulk publication.
sections.zh:
管理员可按站点及内容类型建立工作流，增加阶段及转换、要求评论，并按角色限制转换。新工作流会接纳已有未发布内容，而已发布内容暂时豁免，直到修订或重新发布令其进入流程；改变审稿政策时应同时检查存量内容及新草稿。

工作流指南明确描述：角色有 Publish 权限、却无法访问下一阶段时可用 Publish Override。这是授权设计中的跳过方式，所以单有流程图不能证明审批职责已强制隔离。应以实际权限测试作者、审阅者和发布者，包括退回及覆盖发布；批量工作流推进也不同于批量发布。

sections.title_en: Distinguish background work from a saved public version
sections.title_zh: 区分后台工作与已保存公开版本
sections.en:
The lifecycle guide describes WIP background saves during editing, recoverable from the profile menu, and drafts that are visible in the CMS but not to visitors. Revisions can be named and compared to live content. For a correction, create a revision, inspect its changes and publish it or enter the applicable workflow. Background saving does not prove a public update has happened.

Scheduling requires choosing a date and clicking Schedule. Multiple versions can have separate publication dates; an edit to a scheduled asset can merge with or replace its planned content. The guide also allows a revision to merge into the current review position rather than restart at the first step. Agree how substantive changes are reviewed and test the resulting live version. Archive/restore and permanent deletion have different recovery implications.
sections.zh:
生命周期指南描述编辑时后台 WIP 保存，可从个人菜单恢复；草稿在 CMS 可见，但访客不可见。修订可命名并与线上内容比较，更正时创建修订、检查差异，再发布或进入适用工作流。后台保存并不能证明公开更新已经发生。

定时需选择日期并点击 Schedule，不同版本可有不同发布日期；修改已定时内容可合并到或替换计划内容。指南也允许修订合并回当前审阅阶段，而非重新从第一步开始。应约定实质改动如何复审，并测试实际公开版本。归档/恢复与永久删除的恢复影响不同。

sections.title_en: Price capacity, operations and services explicitly
sections.title_zh: 明确容量、运营和服务报价
sections.en:
The public package description includes hosting/CDN, production/QA/UAT environments, media storage, foundational AI, SSO/SAML, monitoring, backups, managed deployments and annual upgrades. It advertises99.9% uptime and SOC2Type2-certified infrastructure. These are vendor statements; the actual contract, audit coverage, exclusions, recovery targets and service credits were not inspected. No security certification is inferred for a particular customer implementation.

Modular items include experimentation, advanced security/resiliency, bring-your-own-cloud, developer enablement, additional users/lower environments and expanded sites/storage/bandwidth. Migration, creative and SEO/AEO/GEO services are separate proposed engagements. Request allowances, overage, support and renewal terms plus the frontend/integration implementation scope; this research did not establish a per-seat price, a free edition or an open-source license for the current commercial product.
sections.zh:
公开套餐描述包含主机/CDN、生产/QA/UAT 环境、媒体存储、基础 AI、SSO/SAML、监控、备份、托管部署及年度升级，并宣传99.9%可用率及基础设施 SOC2Type2认证。这些是厂商陈述，本次未检查实际合同、审计覆盖、排除项、恢复目标和服务抵扣，也不据此推断某客户实现获得安全认证。

可选模块含实验、增强安全/韧性、自带云、开发支持、额外用户/低级环境，以及更多站点/存储/带宽。迁移、创意及 SEO/AEO/GEO服务另议。报价需明确额度、超额、支持、续费及前端/集成实施范围；本次未建立席位单价、免费版或当前商业产品的开源许可。

sections.title_en: Use an editorial pilot to expose delivery gaps
sections.title_zh: 用编辑试点发现交付缺口
sections.en:
Brightspot is a plausible option for an organization coordinating multiple content types, editorial roles and delivery surfaces with a technical team or implementation partner. The managed package can reduce some operating tasks, but a custom workflow, migration or headless frontend still needs ownership and acceptance. A small site seeking a transparent low-cost self-service plan should account for the quote-led process.

Before commitment, run one article from import to review, a scheduled correction, an authorized override and a role that must not publish. Check the public/API result, previous-version recovery and media links. AI assistance and automation remain subject to human content review and actual data/permission settings. No account, API integration, publishing action, recovery, audit or performance benchmark was executed here.
sections.zh:
有技术团队或实施伙伴、需要协调多内容类型、编辑角色及交付终端的机构可评估 Brightspot。托管套餐可承担部分运营任务，但定制工作流、迁移或无头前端仍需责任方及验收。寻找透明低价自助套餐的小站，应考虑报价驱动的采购流程。

签约前可让一篇文章从导入走到审阅，再测试定时更正、授权覆盖发布和无权发布角色；检查公开/API结果、旧版本恢复及媒体链接。AI辅助及自动化仍需人工内容复核和实际数据/权限设置。本次未执行账户、API集成、发布、恢复、审计或性能测试。

research_gaps.en: No numeric fees, included resource limits, contract SLA remedies, audit coverage, backup retention/recovery targets or current commercial source license were verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实数字费用、内含资源额度、合同 SLA补救、审计范围、备份保留/恢复目标或当前商业源码许可。

research_gaps.en: No publishing/override role test, migration, frontend/API integration, AI action, load or restore was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行发布/覆盖权限测试、迁移、前端/API集成、AI操作、负载或恢复。
